value.rationale: The same model has second-order stationary covariance identical to a Gaussian colored-noise surrogate, which is reversible, and sign symmetry kills all odd-degree witnesses. Thus the position-only order-four antisymmetric two-time moment is the lowest-degree observable separating the microscopic processes. Beyond mere non-Gaussianity, the exact ratio interval with opposing short- and long-lag signs shows that a fourth-order arrow-of-time witness changes orientation with lag, a specific limitation on interpreting measurements. This is a motivated structural diagnostic, not a routine recomputation of a known stationary moment.
